newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-WEIS WINS HAMMER WORLD TITLE WITH LAST ATTEMPT.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-WEIS WINS HAMMER WORLD TITLE WITH LAST ATTEMPT.

text.p: A last effort of 81.78 metres gave German Heinz Weis the hammer gold on the second day of the world championships on Sunday.
Weis, 34, who had won many honours but was still chasing his first major title, was second to Ukraine's Andrei Skvaruk before his final attempt.
Skvaruk had been seemingly out of medal contention when he took the lead with his sixth and final throw of 81.46 metres.
But Weis responded with his winning throw and yelled with joy before falling into his rival's arms.
Skvaruk had to be content with silver while Russian Vasiliy Sidorenko took the bronze with 80.76 metres.
